Project Description: 
 This project is to design and build a proxy application in Amazon Web Services platform for Thomson Reuters applications to interface with the Amazon Alexa speech APIs. 
 
 Contractor Role: 
 
 This role involves designing and building an AWS-hosted application in collaboration with product owners and technology architects. Must be able to work independently as a consultant and developer, investigating and implementing new technologies, and be able to clearly communicate status and roadblocks. 
 
 Required Skills: 
 Minimum of 8 years software engineering experience including: 
 • At least one (production) project deployed to AWS and maintained for 6 months 
 • 6 months of Scala Development experience on workplace projects 
 • Experience building JSON REST APIs 
 • Using a variety of open source software and tools 
 
 Experience preferred including one or more of the following: 
 • Experience with Postgres 
 • Experience with Kibana 
 • Experience with Docker

 Bachelors
